programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Espanyol" - "Levante"

programme.title: Pawn Stars Do America
programme.desc: For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series "Pawn Stars Do America." Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

programme.title: Secrets Declassified with David Duchovny
programme.desc: From black ops and bizarre experiments to deadly cover-ups and nefarious gadgets, David Duchovny pulls the curtain back on all the government secrets in modern history we always suspected, but were never given the answers to.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: The UnXplained: Mysteries of the Universe
programme.desc: We've been fascinated by our nearest planetary neighbor, Venus. It's about the same size as our world, covered in massive volcanoes and poisonous clouds of acid rain. Is Venus our evil twin or a warning about what Earth will become in the future?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd
programme.desc: Picture this: a full-body gas mask for babies. How about Smell-o-Vision? Or a robot powered by eating slugs? These are all real inventions, and we've got them covered including inflatable airplanes and hidden cameras in your contact lenses.

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: As humans encroach ever further into their environment Asian elephants are learning to adjust to the challenges facing them. They know how to use tools to break down electric fences, strike deals with farmers and have developed a co-operative arrangement on tea plantations where they do the weeding without damaging the crops.

programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: The Congo rainforest is home to one of the world's most elusive species, the African Forest elephant. Everything about them; their bodies, their behaviours, their families, is adapted to life in the rainforest. But surviving here means more than just adapting. These elephants have shaped the forest around them to their needs, and in doing so have created a habitat unlike any other on Earth.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators: Compilation
programme.desc: Our rivers and oceans are ruthless battlefields, constantly testing the bravery of even the biggest and deadliest carnivores. Regardless of temperature, depth or terrain, every marine habitat calls for unique body designs, exquisitely evolved senses, and outrageously complex - or bizarre - tactics for success.

programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: Big families and strong relationships are the basis of success for Savanna elephants. As we uncover their secrets we start to understand their remarkable language. It's not just noise, they communicate like us. Good leadership and close friendships help them through the hard times, as they scale cliffs, find their place in the hierarchy and mourn their dead.

programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: As humans encroach ever further into their environment Asian elephants are learning to adjust to the challenges facing them. They know how to use tools to break down electric fences, strike deals with farmers and have developed a co-operative arrangement on tea plantations where they do the weeding without damaging the crops.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: At first glance the desert of India's north-west appear devoid of life. But even in the most hostile environments wildlife thrives. In this inhospitable place, only the best adapted survive. Here, in the harsh deserts and salty drylands, live India's specialists. They have to endure extreme hardship, sandstorms, droughts, and intense heat.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan shares his distinct take on the underdogs using gross-out tactics to win the game of life. With manatees using flatulence to control their buoyancy to cave-dwelling fungus gnats creating beautifully illuminated flytraps with mucus from their butts, these underdogs are out to prove who may be the grossest survivor of them all.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Forget the birds and the bees, Ryan reveals the steps to finding "the one," underdog style. From first attraction in giant-nosed proboscis monkeys to the importance of wingmen in turkey courtship or even foreplay with flying foxes, these animals are rewriting the rule book on messy and complicated relationships in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds puts the spotlight on the underdogs who get ahead by dishonest means. From the master-of-disguise frogfish to a butt-biting jackal and a multiheaded caterpillar playing the decoy, they are the masters of deception and deceit. And bringing all these hustlers together is the greatest con artist of them all - a cunning macaque who feeds on the spoils from unsuspecting tourists.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees

But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: Secreted away in the shadow of the Himalayas, along the banks of the Brahmaputra River, roam One-Horned Rhinoceroses, Wild Buffalo and Asian Elephants. The last great herds of India's giant grazers. It is January, and six months of drought, fire and flood lay ahead of them. Seen through the eyes of a newborn elephant calf, this film portrays a land of unexpected contrasts and endless variety, unique to India and the world.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: This is the real story of the jungles made famous in Rudyard Kipling's 'Jungle Book'. It is a battlefield ruled by tooth and claw, where species fight for space, water, food, and mating rights. This is a world that knows nothing of compassion or kindness, dominated by two of the world's top predators, the Bengal Tiger and the Indian Wild Dog or Dhole. Kipling's Jungle Book was fiction. This is hard fact and a story that rewrites itself every year.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: At first glance the desert of India's north-west appear devoid of life. But even in the most hostile environments wildlife thrives. programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. programme.title: World's Biggest Sharks
programme.desc: After a chance encounter with not one … not two … but three massive sharks, shark experts around the globe are on a quest to discover the world's biggest shark. Evidence of more super-sized sharks lurking below the surface leads them to the waters around the Florida Keys, elusive lagoons in French Polynesia, and remote locations surrounding the Hawaiian Islands. Their mission is to not only locate what might be the world's biggest shark but also to uncover the incredible forces that make some of these apex predators so massive. From highly evolved survival strategies, such as teamwork and hunting, to pupping sanctuaries, scavenging tactics and powerhouse genetics, discover how survival of the fittest breeds these behemoths of the deep.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: At the end of the Ghost River lies an ancient salt pan. Instinct drives thousands of animals from across the Kalahari to converge here, seeking refuge in one of Africa's greatest gambles — where an extraordinary transformation can turn dust and death into life, almost overnight. But this refuge is fickle and exists on unreliable annual rainfall. This year, will Nxai Pan provide a life-giving stopover on Kalahari's greatest migratory route, or will it mean death in the dust for all?

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom

Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol Compilations
programme.desc: In this special episode, Dr. Pol and the vets take their show on the road, making house calls and bringing their expertise straight to the farm. From pigs to alpacas, these vets can do it all! Dr. Pol starts his day right with 26 puppy health checks, and Dr. Brenda fawns over a few baby white-tailed deer. Dr. Lisa helps a mother cow in a prickly situation and saves a favorite horse from choking. While Dr. Pol assists an alpaca struggling to breathe and checks on an ornery camel, Dr. Nicole assists a mama pig through a difficult labor to deliver piglets.

programme.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory travels to the Baja Peninsula in Mexico in search of one of the ocean's most distinctive predators: the hammerhead shark. Once a defining presence in these waters, the hammerhead shark's numbers have fallen dramatically. Bertie investigates what has driven its decline and what hope it has for recovery.

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: In Gracetown, Australia, two surfers are attacked just a few hours apart on the same beach. In New South Wales, another surfer has a close call when a great white takes a bite of his board. And in Tampa, Florida, a juvenile bull shark injures a girl paddleboarding with her family. At surf spots across the globe, sharks attack surfers at alarming rates. Recent data shows surfers account for a third of unprovoked shark bites worldwide. What is it about riding the breaks that has sharks seeing red? Researchers investigate terrifying close calls and gruesome attacks from America to Australia. They examine evidence and test theories to learn why surfers remain high on the shark hit list, all in the hope of saving lives.

programme.title: World's Biggest Mako
programme.desc: A team of scientists and a cinematographer searched the waters north of New Zealand to find giant mako. With the help of a local fisherman, who has worked this stretch of ocean for decades, they encounter a series of increasingly large mako sharks. While endangered elsewhere on the planet, this team discovers a population of mako that might be making a comeback.

programme.title: Shark Side Of the Moon
programme.desc: Shark Side of the Moon presents an unprecedented glimpse into the fascinating lives of hammerhead sharks and their surprising connection to the moon.

programme.title: Surfing Hippos - Gabon's Jungle Beach
programme.desc: On the western edge of Central Africa, where the Congo rainforest meets the Atlantic Ocean, lies one of the planet's last great wilderness frontiers: the coast of Gabon. Here, forest elephants, hippos, antelopes, monkeys and countless other animals emerge from the jungle onto remote beaches, drawn by food, minerals, shelter and the sea itself. Some hippos even venture into the surf. By night, the shoreline becomes a cradle of life, shaped by ancient rhythms that have endured for millennia, but this fragile paradise is under threat. Ocean currents now carry plastic waste to shores once considered untouched.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Veteran Safari Guide Paul Templer and his ambitious apprentice Evans Namasango are leading a group down a calm stretch of the Zambezi River. This relaxing tour takes a turn for the worse when an aggressive hippo repeatedly strikes, leaving the Safari Guides fighting for survival. On the very same stretch of water 14 years later, Javier Franco is on vacation with his wife and two children. Their river safari does not last long before disaster strikes.

From pigs to alpacas, these vets can do it all! Dr. Pol starts his day right with 26 puppy health checks, and Dr. Brenda fawns over a few baby white-tailed deer. Dr. Lisa helps a mother cow in a prickly situation and saves a favorite horse from choking. While Dr. Pol assists an alpaca struggling to breathe and checks on an ornery camel, Dr. Nicole assists a mama pig through a difficult labor to deliver piglets.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Surfing Hippos - Gabon's Jungle Beach
programme.desc: On the western edge of Central Africa, where the Congo rainforest meets the Atlantic Ocean, lies one of the planet's last great wilderness frontiers: the coast of Gabon. Here, forest elephants, hippos, antelopes, monkeys and countless other animals emerge from the jungle onto remote beaches, drawn by food, minerals, shelter and the sea itself. Some hippos even venture into the surf. By night, the shoreline becomes a cradle of life, shaped by ancient rhythms that have endured for millennia, but this fragile paradise is under threat. Ocean currents now carry plastic waste to shores once considered untouched.

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: In Gracetown, Australia, two surfers are attacked just a few hours apart on the same beach. In New South Wales, another surfer has a close call when a great white takes a bite of his board. And in Tampa, Florida, a juvenile bull shark injures a girl paddleboarding with her family. At surf spots across the globe, sharks attack surfers at alarming rates. Recent data shows surfers account for a third of unprovoked shark bites worldwide. What is it about riding the breaks that has sharks seeing red? Researchers investigate terrifying close calls and gruesome attacks from America to Australia. They examine evidence and test theories to learn why surfers remain high on the shark hit list, all in the hope of saving lives.

programme.title: World's Biggest Sharks
programme.desc: After a chance encounter with not one … not two … but three massive sharks, shark experts around the globe are on a quest to discover the world's biggest shark. Evidence of more super-sized sharks lurking below the surface leads them to the waters around the Florida Keys, elusive lagoons in French Polynesia, and remote locations surrounding the Hawaiian Islands. Their mission is to not only locate what might be the world's biggest shark but also to uncover the incredible forces that make some of these apex predators so massive. From highly evolved survival strategies, such as teamwork and hunting, to pupping sanctuaries, scavenging tactics and powerhouse genetics, discover how survival of the fittest breeds these behemoths of the deep.

programme.title: World's Biggest Mako
programme.desc: A team of scientists and a cinematographer searched the waters north of New Zealand to find giant mako. With the help of a local fisherman, who has worked this stretch of ocean for decades, they encounter a series of increasingly large mako sharks. While endangered elsewhere on the planet, this team discovers a population of mako that might be making a comeback.

programme.title: Shark Side Of the Moon
programme.desc: Shark Side of the Moon presents an unprecedented glimpse into the fascinating lives of hammerhead sharks and their surprising connection to the moon.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Cecil: The Legacy of A King
programme.desc: In the heart of Zimbabwe's Hwange National Park, beneath towering mahogany and mopani trees, roamed one of Africa's most legendary lions-Cecil. Known for his immense size and regal presence, he was a dominant force in the wild long before his tragic fate at the hands of hunters made global headlines. While his death sparked international outrage, Cecil: The Legacy of a King shifts the focus to his extraordinary life. A warrior, a father, and a leader, Cecil's story is one of strength, survival, and the bonds that define a pride. This documentary honors the legacy of a lion who was more than just a symbol-he was a king.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs have spent their whole lives in the maternity unit but will venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn. Mini Ling Lang, the oldest of the summer cubs, discovers her mum is an expert climber and tries to take after her. Su Jin Junior is headstrong, and his mom keeps him in line with a no-nonsense teaching style. The little twins are too young to start climbing, but they put their best paw forward when snow arrives. A snow day doesn't mean school is canceled; it means the lessons will be harder. While the littlest cubs are starting their schooling, Tian Tian's cub is up in the mountains and coming to the end of his lessons … inching closer to a life in the wild.

programme.title: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Veteran Safari Guide Paul Templer and his ambitious apprentice Evans Namasango are leading a group down a calm stretch of the Zambezi River. This relaxing tour takes a turn for the worse when an aggressive hippo repeatedly strikes, leaving the Safari Guides fighting for survival. On the very same stretch of water 14 years later, Javier Franco is on vacation with his wife and two children. Their river safari does not last long before disaster strikes.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: THE BIG CAT GAMES is a high-end, high-profile television event that pits the world's most ferocious land predators against each other in a series of challenges that will push them to the limits of their athletic abilities.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Cecil: The Legacy of A King

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Set in Botswana's vast and untamed wilderness, "Big Little Giants" follows Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps into a challenging world shaped by drought, predators and ancient migration routes. From a newborn elephant learning to keep pace with its herd to jackal pups testing their instincts and cheetah cubs preparing for life at astonishing speed, each story unfolds through intimate moments of learning and loss. Guided by parents, siblings and instinct, these young animals must quickly adapt or fall behind. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Tree Climbing Lions
programme.desc: Big cat biologist Alexander Braczkowski is on a mission. He's got 90 days to count lions in Uganda and learn how the population is doing. But these aren't ordinary lions. The prides in Queen Elizabeth National Park spend most of their lives up in the trees, a rare and mysterious behavior unique to this part of Africa.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Living together for the first time, half-siblings Jack and Lily are pushed outside their comfort zones as they learn to coexist while navigating new family dynamics, friends, and endless hijinks all while helping run the family's pet grooming and boarding business. With guidance from their parents and grandmother, the two will learn about each other's previously separate lives, blended identity, vibrant culture, and the importance of family.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Spongicus: Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket! No one in Bikini Bottom can resist, not even Mr. Krabs! Suction Cup Symphony: The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win. He immediately gets to work on his masterpiece, but when SpongeBob and Patrick keep disrupting Squidward's concentration, it looks like they might ruin his chance at musical stardom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Not Normal: When Squidward points out to SpongeBob that he's not normal, SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal. programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: The Twisted Timeline of Sammy and Raj
programme.desc: Sammy and Raj are looking forward to a quiet night in when they get surprised with a Hugo slumber party! // The boys are shocked to discover Kunal had a passion for magic when he was young. This could come in handy...

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Non ci resta che piangere
programme.desc: Un maestro elementare e un bidello si ritrovano, per uno strano scherzo del caso, nel 1492. Decidono di recarsi a Palos, in Andalusia, per fermare Cristoforo Colombo e impedirgli di scoprire le Americhe.

programme.title: A beautiful mind
programme.desc: 4 Oscar e 4 Golden Globe per il capolavoro di Ron Howard con Russell Crowe e Jennifer Connelly. L'avvincente biografia di John Nash, genio matematico e premio Nobel affetto da schizofrenia.

programme.title: C'era una volta a New York
programme.desc: Nella New York degli anni Venti, le sorelle polacche Ewa e Magda emigrano dalla Polonia a New York. Giunte a Ellis Island, scoprono che Magda è malata di tubercolosi e viene messa in quarantena. Ewa si ritrova sola e indifesa.

programme.title: Il texano dagli occhi di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Leggendario western diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood. Alla fine della Guerra di Secessione, una banda di nordisti si accanisce contro un contadino sudista e la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Stranizza d'amuri
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Giuseppe Fiorello. Sicilia, anni 80: due adolescenti, Gianni e Nino, sono costretti a tenere segreto il sentimento che li lega a causa dei pregiudizi contro l'omosessualità.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Jarhead
programme.desc: Swofford, arruolato come suo padre e suo nonno prima di lui, durante l'operazione Desert Storm, nella prima Guerra del Golfo, attraversa i deserti mediorientali con i soldati iracheni sempre potenzialmente all'orizzonte.

programme.title: Boy Erased - Vite cancellate
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman, Lucas Hedges e Russell Crowe in una sconvolgente storia vera. Il figlio di un predicatore confessa la propria omosessualita' e viene iscritto a un programma riabilitativo.

programme.title: Invictus - L'invincibile
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Morgan Freeman e Matt Damon in un biopic sportivo. Sudafrica, 1995. Per il presidente Mandela, la coppa del mondo di rugby è l'occasione per unire bianchi e neri.

programme.title: Ray
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al biopic su Ray Charles con Jamie Foxx. Dall'infanzia al successo, passando per i suoi controversi lati oscuri, la vita del leggendario "The Genius" della musica black.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: 12 anni schiavo
programme.desc: Steve McQueen dirige Chiwetel Ejiofor e Michael Fassbender in un biopic premiato con 3 Oscar. Nella Louisiana dell'800, un violinista afroamericano viene rapito e ridotto in schiavitù.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: Boy Erased - Vite cancellate
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman, Lucas Hedges e Russell Crowe in una sconvolgente storia vera. Il figlio di un predicatore confessa la propria omosessualita' e viene iscritto a un programma riabilitativo.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Mr Vendetta
programme.desc: Su consiglio della sua fidanzata anarchica, un operaio appena licenziato rapisce la figlia del suo ex capo, sperando di usare i soldi del riscatto per pagare il trapianto di rene della sorella.

programme.title: Old Boy
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per il film pulp di Park Chan-Wook. Un uomo, segregato in una stanza per quindici anni, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo sconosciuto aguzzino.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Hasta pronto Viviani
programme.desc: Dodicesima commedia targata Sky, tratta dal mondo dei romanzi di Marco Malvaldi, con Filippo Timi. Mentre Massimo e' sparito in Argentina, l'omicidio di un latitante sconvolge Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Donne con le palle
programme.desc: Tra campionati di beach volley, cervi in fuga e giri di scommesse clandestine i nostri protagonisti del BarLume si troveranno a indagare sull’ennesimo misterioso omicidio.

programme.title: I Delitti Del Barlume - Ritorno A Pineta
programme.desc: A rompere la tranquillita' della stagione estiva di Pineta questa volta e' l'inaspettato ritorno di uno dei suoi cittadini piu' amati: il Viviani del BarLume.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume-Mare forza quattro
programme.desc: Tornano i personaggi di Pineta nel 15esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Una forte mareggiata di fine marzo riporta un cadavere proprio sotto al BarLume.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Tana libera tutti
programme.desc: Sedicesimo film della saga Sky Original con Filippo Timi e Lucia Mascino. Una misteriosa scomparsa mette in subbuglio il Pasquali e i vecchini, chiusi in casa per il lockdown.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Compro oro
programme.desc: Tornano i protagonisti del BarLume nel 17esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre Massimo aiuta la Fusco nelle indagini, una coppia di italoamericani fa il suo ingresso a Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - A bocce ferme
programme.desc: Nuove indagini a Pineta nel 18esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre i vecchini aiutano Massimo e la Fusco, Beppe e Tiziana cercano di ritagliarsi del tempo da soli.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Indovina chi?
programme.desc: Si torna a Pineta nel 19esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Un omicidio costringe Tiziana e Beppe a trasferirsi da Pasquali mentre Viviani e Rimediotti aiutano la Fusco nelle indagini.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Resort Paradiso
programme.desc: Ventesimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original con i protagonisti del BarLume. Fra criminali, omicidi irrisolti e professionisti dell'inganno, un'avventura in cui niente e' come sembra.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - E allora zumba!
programme.desc: Un nuovo caso a Pineta nella 21esima storia della produzione Sky Original. Mentre tutti sono occupati, l'omicidio della pediatra getta nel panico un papa' iper ansioso come Beppe.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il pozzo dei desideri
programme.desc: 22esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Un morto in un pozzo dà il via all’estate con un caso per la Fusco, uno sfratto per Massimo, Tizi e Beppe e un guaio per Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La girata
programme.desc: Nuove indagini nel 23esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Durante una battuta di caccia tra amici ci scappa il morto. Un incidente? Solo la Fusco e Massimo sapranno darci una risposta.

programme.title: Unicorni
programme.desc: Blu è un bambino che sogna di interpretare la Sirenetta. Suo padre Lucio non sa come affrontare le richieste del figlio mentre sua moglie, Elena, tende ad assecondare le richieste di Blu. Il gruppo di "Genitori Unicorni" sostiene la famiglia.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: Adattamento Sky Original di un classico racconto gotico di Natale. Una donna riceve dal misterioso Mr. Blunden l'offerta di lavorare come custode di una casa che potrebbe essere infestata.

programme.title: Paws of Fury: La leggenda di Hank
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura animata targata Sky Original. Hank, un adorabile cane che sogna di diventare samurai, prende lezioni da un maestro, ma un perfido gatto minaccia il villaggio.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Spongebob: Un'avventura Da Pirati
programme.desc: SpongeBob, in compagnia degli inseparabili amici Patrick, Squiddi, Sandy e Mr. Krabs, intraprende un viaggio nelle profondità dell'oceano per affrontare il fantasma dell'Olandese volante.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Oscar 2012 al miglior film d'animazione. Un bizzarro camaleonte giunge in una cittadina del selvaggio West oppressa dalla siccità e da una spietata banda di fuorilegge senza scrupoli.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Ricercati in Europa
programme.desc: Terza avventura e nuovo continente per il leone Alex, la zebra Marty, la giraffa Melman e l'ippopotamo Gloria, che si troveranno in Europa braccati dalla spietata agente DuBois.

programme.title: Unicorni
programme.desc: Blu è un bambino che sogna di interpretare la Sirenetta. Suo padre Lucio non sa come affrontare le richieste del figlio mentre sua moglie, Elena, tende ad assecondare le richieste di Blu. Il gruppo di "Genitori Unicorni" sostiene la famiglia.

programme.title: Lego Batman - Il film
programme.desc: Animazione digitale e mattoncini Lego si combinano di nuovo per un’avventura targata DC. Batman si allea con la Justice League per sconfiggere i supercattivi capitanati da Joker.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.desc: Avventura animata nel mondo dei pirati. A caccia di un diamante fatato, Capitan Sciabola incontrerà uno scaltro orfanello, un giovane corsaro e un'avventurosa e intraprendente fanciulla.

programme.desc: Il trio di comici più amato d'Italia in una commedia sul matrimonio e l'amicizia. Legati sin dall'infanzia, i futuri consuoceri Giovanni e Giacomo organizzano una cerimonia lussuosa per le nozze dei rispettivi figli. L'arrivo del pasticcione Aldo metterà sottosopra l'evento.

programme.title: Come un gatto in tangenziale
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Antonio Albanese in un'ironica commedia romantica. Un intellettuale e una cassiera si alleano per interrompere la love story fra i rispettivi figli adolescenti.

programme.title: Bianco, rosso e verdone
programme.desc: Commedia da antologia di Carlo Verdone che interpreta tre personaggi in altrettanti episodi. L’ingenuo Mimmo, il pedante Furio e il taciturno Pasquale viaggiano verso Roma per le elezioni.

programme.title: Nati CON La Camicia
programme.desc: Rosco Fraker è uno stravagante ventriloquo che gira il mondo in pattini a rotelle, Doug O'Riordan un ex detenuto dal pugno facile e il cuore tenero, appena uscito di galera. I due si incontrano in un bar, nel bel mezzo di una rissa.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: Ti ripresento i tuoi
programme.desc: Il regista di "Giu' al Nord", Dany Boon dirige e interpreta una commedia degli equivoci. Un architetto nasconde le sue umili origini, ma un giorno i suoi genitori si presentano a Parigi.

programme.title: Toilet
programme.desc: Commedia di e con Gabriele Pignotta e le voci di Lillo, Francesco Pannofino e Vanessa Incontrada. Un manager in viaggio rimane chiuso nel bagno di una stazione di servizio deserta.

programme.title: Colpi d'amore
programme.desc: Action-comedy con i premi Oscar Ke Huy Quan e Ariana DeBose. Un agente immobiliare, ex killer al servizio di un'organizzazione criminale, deve regolare i conti con il passato di cui pensava di essersi liberato e con la donna di cui era innamorato.

programme.title: Come può uno scoglio
programme.desc: Torna la comicità dirompente di Pio e Amedeo ancora diretti da Gennaro Nunziante. La vita di Pio, avvocato dal carattere remissivo, viene stravolta dall'incontro con il vulcanico Amedeo.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: I pompieri
programme.desc: Lino Banfi e Massimo Boldi fra incendi e allagamenti, in un mare di risate. Due vigili del fuoco in pensione ritornano in servizio unendosi ai colleghi più giovani della disastrosa squadra 17, il cui caposquadra è affetto da sonnambulismo. Oltre ai guai in cui finiscono ogni volta che affrontano una missione, questi goffi pompieri dovranno vedersela con lo zelante comandante della caserma e con un fastidioso giornalista alla ricerca continua di scoop. Cast arricchito da Christian De Sica, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato e da un cameo di Moana Pozzi.

programme.title: Mamma o papà?
